summary: This dataset describes the investigation of the role of homocysteine (Hcy) in age-related macular degeneration (AMD) using mouse models. The study aims to understand the molecular and cellular mechanisms of Hcy-induced retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) dysfunction and choroidal neovascularization (CNV), which are characteristic of AMD. The research involves in vitro and in vivo experiments using RPE and choroidal endothelial cells, as well as mouse models with genetic or pharmacological modifications to test the hypotheses that Hcy induces a metabolic switch from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis via GLUT1 activation and that inhibition of N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDAr) receptors preserves RPE function and reduces CNV.
